card.name: Digits inside concentration values
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a number that is a concentration, level or dose range, usually just before a unit such as mg/mL, ng/mL, mcg/mL or mg/kg.

modes.label: Blood or plasma levels
modes.description: Digit in a drug level figure given in ng/mL, pg/mL or mcg/mL.
modes.example: symptoms of toxicity have been reported at levels as low as <<8>>00 ng/mL

modes.label: Product strengths and ratios
modes.description: Digit in an injection strength such as 2.5 mg/mL or a dilution ratio.
modes.example: Bupivacaine Hydrochloride Bupivacaine Hydrochloride and Epinephrine 0.25% (2.<<5>> mg/mL) 0.5%

modes.label: Dose ranges
modes.description: Digit in the second number of a dose range per kg.
